anchors.name: sota_ref_n15
anchors.derivation: Cohn et al.'s Spherical Codes database: best-known n=15 configuration on S^2 has minimal angular separation with cosine 0.59260590292507377809642492233276 (minimal polynomial 13x^5 - x^4 + 6x^3 + 2x^2 - 3x - 1). Not proven optimal. n=14 was proven optimal by O. R. Musin, A. S. Tarasov, "The Tammes problem for N=14," Exp. Math. 24 (2015), 460-468, establishing n=15 as the first open case.
